section_summary: This section concludes one copy and contains another copy of a translated Japanese ordinance revising enforcement of the Machine Tool Manufacturing Industry Law, including provisions on licensing thresholds, taxation, compensation, compulsory transfers, adjudication, depreciation, and transitional arrangements. It also contains two copies of a price-control amendment governing export goods and raw materials. The final document revises immigration rules for aliens entering, remaining in, transiting, or departing the Japanese South Seas Mandate.

subfiles.title: Revision in the Ordinance Pertaining to Enforcement of the Machine Tool Manufacturing Industry Law (conclusion)
subfiles.doc_type: translated imperial ordinance with reference extracts
subfiles.about: The concluding pages prescribe tax and capital calculations for machine-tool enterprises and reproduce transitional provisions from the revised Machine Tool Manufacturing Industry Law.
subfiles.summary: Machine Tool Manufacturing Industry Law revision (conclusion): rules for capital calculation, tax exemption applications and import reports in manufacturers' names, with transitional provisions from Law 70 of 1941.

subfiles.title: Revision in the Ordinance Pertaining to Enforcement of the Machine Tool Manufacturing Industry Law
subfiles.doc_type: translated imperial ordinance with reference extracts
subfiles.about: The ordinance revises the enforcement regime for Japan’s Machine Tool Manufacturing Industry Law and appends extracts from the earlier regulations and the 1941 statutory revision.
subfiles.summary: The ordinance revises licensing thresholds, terminology, capital calculations, and procedures for claiming exemptions from income, corporation, and business-profit taxes. It regulates compensation for losses caused by government orders, negotiations and adjudication over expenses and transfers, compulsory assignment or leasing of machines and tools, payment and deposit procedures, and publication of decisions. Further provisions authorize accelerated depreciation and restrict the use of reserve funds, while supplementary rules establish a five-year transition. Reference extracts reproduce relevant provisions of the 1938 enforcement regulations and Law No. 70 of 1941.

subfiles.title: Revision in Price Control Ordinance Enforcement Regulations
subfiles.about: The amendment revises controlled-price provisions for export goods, export raw materials, and transactions conducted through distribution or adjustment organs.
subfiles.summary: Cabinet Ordinance 24 revises Article 15 of the Price Control Ordinance regulations on prices for designated raw materials imported for export goods and goods handled by trade-control adjustment organs.

subfiles.title: Revision in Price Control Ordinance Enforcement Regulations (duplicate copy)
subfiles.about: This duplicate enclosure repeats the amendment governing controlled prices for export goods and their raw materials.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate copy of Cabinet Ordinance 24 revising Article 15 of the Price Control Ordinance regulations, with the 1939 language.

subfiles.title: Revision in the Rules Pertaining to the Entry, Stay and Departure of Aliens
subfiles.doc_type: translated South Sea Islands government ordinance
subfiles.from: Shunsuke Kondo, Governor of the South Sea Islands
subfiles.about: The ordinance revises passport, visa, entry, residence, transit, fee, and departure requirements for aliens in the South Seas Mandate.
subfiles.summary: South Sea Islands Government Ordinance No. 41 tightens rules governing aliens’ passports, visas, transit certificates, permitted landing places, and periods of stay. It authorizes officials to bar entry, grant special entry or transit permission, designate residence and travel conditions, and require advance permission for departure. The ordinance establishes exemptions from fees, penalties for violations, and transitional treatment for visas and transit certificates issued before its enforcement.
